title: Exact finite threshold and optimal factor partitions for products of simplices
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; one separately tasked AI reviewer. Not human peer review.
claim: For products of standard simplices with every factor dimension at least two, the first violation of the simplex projection-volume benchmark occurs in dimension 20, uniquely maximized by (10,10). Exact maxima and all optimal partitions are checked through dimension 40; the first optimal three-factor partition is (11,11,11) at 33.

verification.second: Exhaustive unordered-partition recursion using exact Fraction/factorial products, written in the same coordinating AI session.
verification.separate_reviewer: Factor-size-first rational knapsack and Euler-product partition counts; same formula and Python arithmetic dependencies.
verification.reproduce: python reproduce.py in pinned packet; standard library only.
verification.geometry: Written Cauchy/Fubini reduction; not machine-verified geometry.
